title: A wish for a rolling game that grows from pyramid to sphere, built in four minutes
summary: On Thu 19 Nov at 01:17Z, in the thread under the pink-mug post (see made-polyhedral-coffee-simulator), @cee.wtf (2,524 followers) asked the build bot @buildthis.bisks.net for "katamari but you start with a pyramid and every time you pick an item up it adds another vertex to your polyhedron until you get all the way to a sphere". The bot replied at 01:21Z with polykatamari.bisks.net. @cee.wtf then asked for it to "actually roll irregularly instead of faking it" (02:09Z; answered 02:12Z: "Now it really tips: pivots over its lowest vertex, lurching up onto each corner and dropping onto the next face") and for "a jazzy japanese sountrack of your own creation and sound effects" (02:14Z; answered 02:16Z with "a swung jazz loop in a Japanese scale (koto plucks, Rhodes, walking bass, brushes) that gets busier as you grow"). At 02:16Z @cee.wtf posted the link with "This is a high quality bisk" (48 likes). A further update at 05:08Z added two-stick controls. The bot is run by @bisks.net; it makes a small website for a request posted to it and replies with the address (see made-build-bot-daily-slot).

made.what: polykatamari: a rolling game in which the player starts as a square pyramid and gains a vertex with each pickup until it is a sphere

couldBeShown: A square pyramid rolling by tipping over its lowest vertex, picking things up, gaining a vertex each time and rounding toward a sphere; "Bigger things are walls till you grow"; a soundtrack that "gets busier as you grow". These are the bot's descriptions of what it built; research has not seen the game.
